tools.name: pixelvault_api_overview
tools.description: Explain how to use the PixelVault image-hosting API: register for a key, upload an image, apply transforms, and connect the MCP server. Returns the endpoints, auth model, and free-tier limits.

tools.name: pixelvault_build_transform_url
tools.description: Given a PixelVault CDN image URL (https://img.pixelvault.dev/...), append on-the-fly transform parameters and return the ready-to-use URL — no re-upload or API call. Params: w, h, fit (scale-down|contain|cover|crop|pad), fmt (auto|webp|avif|jpg|png), q, blur, sharpen, rotate (90|180|270), flip (h|v|hv), segment (foreground = AI background removal), brightness, contrast, saturation, background, gravity, zoom, tile, size (s|m|l|social).

url.description: A PixelVault CDN URL, e.g. https://img.pixelvault.dev/proj/img.jpg
